description: This Java class implements the CommandStrategy interface to retrieve loan details by ID within a batch processing context for the Fineract project. It handles parsing of relative URLs, extraction and addition of query parameters, and delegates the retrieval of loan data to the LoansApiResource, encapsulating the logic for batch API calls to fetch a specific loan by its ID.

classes.name: GetLoanByIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component class that implements command strategy to retrieve loan details by loan ID in batch operations, handling URL parsing, query parameter extraction, and delegation to the LoansApiResource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command strategy to retrieve a loan by ID, parsing relative URL, extracting query parameters, calling the LoansApiResource, and forming a BatchResponse.

methods.name: getQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts query parameters from a relative URL string and returns them as a map.

methods.name: addQueryParametersToUriInfo
methods.description: Adds parsed query parameters to the MutableUriInfo object for proper API request formation.
